document.business_rules:
1. Start with Accessories counted, Stored data erased, Power test passed, and Chain of custody checked off; no disposition. Stored data erased is disabled and forced off when dataBearing is false. Other inspection checks remain actual user decisions, not fixture-driven automatic approvals.
2. Base intake eligibility requires Accessories counted and, for data-bearing items, Stored data erased. Return to stock additionally requires Power test passed and restockAllowed. Send for repair requires repairAllowed plus base eligibility; Send for recycling requires recycleAllowed plus base eligibility. Show every route even when disabled.
3. Routes are single selection. Any inspection change clears chain-of-custody approval and clears the selected route only when that route becomes ineligible. A route change clears custody approval. Custody approval is enabled only with a selected eligible route. Record disposition requires that route and custody approval.
4. Submit emits exactly one 'route-return|{entityId}|{restock/repair/recycle}|power:{pass/unchecked}|data:{erased/not-required}|accessories:counted', then locks all controls. All other taps emit nothing. The published eligibility rules ensure a data-bearing submit always uses erased.
5. Same-entity replacement preserves accessories and power checks, preserves data-erased only while the replacement is data-bearing, preserves a route only if still eligible, and clears custody approval and recorded state. Changed entityId clears all checks, route, approval, and recorded status, including reused labels. Replacement emits nothing.
6. The summary displays all four facts in this order: 'Accessories counted/unchecked · Data erased/pending/not required · Power passed/unchecked · Route {restock/repair/recycle/none}'. This is an intake routing request, not proof of actual erasure, repair, or external inventory mutation.

measurementSources.palette: Stock Reply ui/theme/Color.kt, light palette, lines 23–57; iOS adopts these explicit component colors because AlertToast.AlertStyle accepts arbitrary SwiftUI Color.
measurementSources.androidTypography: Stock Reply ui/theme/Type.kt titleLarge (22sp,600,28sp line height) and bodyLarge (16sp,400,24sp line height).
measurementSources.iosTypography: Independent design choice: system font, fixed 22pt semibold title, 16pt regular body at approved Large Dynamic Type; visual intent only, no computed SwiftUI font claim.
measurementSources.spacing: Independent design choice, informed by AlertToast.banner VStack leading/spacing10/cornerRadius10 and ReplyEmailListItem Column padding20. This design explicitly fixes its own 16/12/8 rhythm and 16/8 radii, rather than claiming those are upstream defaults.
measurementSources.shape: Stock Reply Shapes.kt supports 8dp small and 16dp medium; iOS adopts explicit matching pt design values.

scope.closed_shape: One eager finite vertical production component. No internal scroll, overlays, asynchronous state, external data, or full app navigation.
scope.fixture_domain: Assessment covers the exact independently sealed family and action prefixes. The reusable public schema supports up to4 data rows per group; unbounded future caller inputs are not certified.
scope.host: 390x600 logical viewport; host inset16 horizontal and24 top; Android density2.75 and explicit paparazzi-float32-screen-config-v1.

heading-visual-size.value: Does the iOS heading follow the annotated reference's fixed22pt system-font size intent and title-to-body scale? This is qualitative, not a computed font reading.

heading-visual-weight.value: Does the iOS heading show the annotated reference's semibold/600 weight intent?

body-visual-size.value: Does iOS body copy follow the annotated reference's fixed16pt regular system-font size intent? This is qualitative typography, not a computed point-size observation.

body-visual-ink.value: Does iOS body copy follow the reference's dark ink (#FF201B13) visual intent against the white panel? This is a qualitative ink judgment, not computed color.

content-wrap.value: Across the complete swept state, is every supplied description, choice detail, summary, status, and current preview readable through natural wrapping, without ellipsis or a clipped final line?

content-overlap.value: Across the complete swept state, do successive vertical blocks remain separate without overlapping or occluding one another?

obligations.clause: All supplied and computed business text is current and exact.
Native disabled/selected facts obey published business decisions.
Exact tap event intervals require demonstrated successful original native dispatch; blocked taps never prove quiet behavior.
Same-entity revalidation and changed-entity reset are distinct and callback-silent.
Typography follows sourced native or qualitative platform intent.
Full variable-length vertical content wraps, fits and preserves separation/insets.
Component opaque fills match approved suitable pixel regions; primary ink is readable.
Primary control accessibility-box height is48pt/dp; no physical OS hit-area claim.
Visible selection marks agree with native selected facts.
Panel and option corner shape follow independent annotated references.
